'''Skeleton Archers''' are monsters that appear in the third section of the [[The Shadow Reef]] on the bridge section. They cannot be reached, but can be harmed with reflect damage, such as [[Reflect]] and [[Deflect Missiles]]; if the player is wearing [[cinderbane gloves]] or has used any type of [[weapon poison]], they can also be poisoned through reflect damage.
